articles.title: Trump unbound: the making of an imperial presidency – podcast
articles.description: Donald Trump’s second term is unlike his first. The politicians who challenged him are gone. The lawyers who once pushed back now choose their battles. Few journalists have covered Trump as closely as the New York Times journalist Jonathan Swan.
